From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Telemetry adapter certification playbook — Datadog & OpenTelemetry adapter

Hi Maria / TechTide team,

Following up from last week's call — thanks again for taking time. We're proposing a lightweight certification playbook for the Redwood -> Datadog ingestion path when customers use the OpenTelemetry-based adapter. Goal: have a reproducible checklist so partners can validate ingestion, tracing, metrics, and tag/attribute mappings across common customer setups.

High level asks:
- TechTide: confirm any known gaps in our OTLP/Datadog exporter mapping (sampling, resource attributes)
- Datadog: provide your compliance checklist and any test data templates you prefer
- Redwood: we will assemble a runbook and run two pilot integrations (one internal staging account, one partner-managed sandbox)

Proposed timeline:
1) Share compliance checklist + example sample payloads (this week)
2) Joint test plan + runbook v0.1 (by 11/18)
3) Pilot kickoff and live run (week of 11/22)

Attachments: pilot_kickoff_agenda.pdf (draft agenda).

If this looks good I'll coordinate resources (Marcus for infra, Hannah for telemetry QA) and schedule a 30m kickoff.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Partnerships (Observability)
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: pilot_kickoff_agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Maria Perez <maria.perez@datadoghq.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, TechTide Consulting <observability@techtide.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 13:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Telemetry adapter certification playbook — Datadog & OpenTelemetry adapter

Thanks Priya — this sounds sensible.

I attached our standard compliance_checklist.xlsx that covers authentication, API rate limits, tag preservation, and APM trace sampling. Two quick asks from our side:
- Can you provide an example OTLP payload (traces + metrics) that represents a typical inference request/response flow? We prefer JSON-lines or gzipped proto samples.
- For metrics, include expected tag/key names for model_name, deployment_id, and shard/host metadata.

We can review the runbook draft once you share it. Happy to join the kickoff — Maria (Datadog) will be available on the 22nd in the afternoon PST.

Best,
Maria Perez
Partner Engineering
Datadog

--
